title: My thoughts after using Clojure for about a month
summary: A developer shares their authentic first-month experience learning and using Clojure, discussing practical insights into the language's Lisp heritage, functional programming paradigm, REPL-driven development workflow, and the challenges of adopting a different programming paradigm after years of imperative coding.
problem_solved: Provides real-world, honest feedback for developers considering learning Clojure or evaluating whether to invest time in this Lisp dialect.
why_valuable: Offers authentic, hands-on experience report that helps others make informed decisions about adopting Clojure, backed by significant community validation (241 HN points).
